Maya P: Quick heads-upwe ran a small canary for the "lockless-prefetch" runtime change in eu-central-1 this morning. Short summary: p95 ~30% down, median ~13% down, throughput +11%, and est infra spend per 1M tokens ~20% lower. :sparkles:
Ravi K: awesome! which workload and window?
Maya P: Mixed-chat synthetic (50/50 short 30t / long 700t) over a 90m steady window. Baseline p95 220ms -> 154ms on canary nodes.
Hannah: any spike in errors or crate-level churn?
Maya P: No sustained error increase. One brief 5xx blip during warmup (~0.03%) that didn't repeat.
Theo: What changed exactly?
Maya P: Replaced a coarse global mutex around prefetch queues with per-shard lockless rings + micro-fusion of prefix-compatible prefetches. Less blocking, smoother GPU feeding.
Ravi K: Memory / KV cache impact?
Maya P: Slight bump in KV resident size (~3-5%) during warmup; steady-state evictions unchanged. Worker memory delta ~2MB.
Maya P: Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 18-24h with automated gates. Rollback if sustained p95 regress >5% or 5xx >0.5% for 5min.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started 2026-03-22T07:12:10Z (eu-central-1 slice).
ops-bot: monitoring configured: p95, error-rate, kv-evict. auto-rollout disabled until manual ack.
Hannah: Please add short runbook and perf artifacts link?
Maya P: Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/lockless-prefetch/4132100000.zip. I'll add a 1-pager runbook to the docs repo today.
Ravi K: nice win, thanks Maya.
Maya P: Thanks team ping me for traces or slices if you want deeper numbers.
